captions.title: Share my link, right on home
captions.line: One tap sends your link, with your invite code in it.

message.label: The message they get
message.text: Join AV Homes with me and earn money on every home you help sell or rent.

captions.title: More ways: Menu, then Invite
captions.line: Your link, WhatsApp and a QR code in one place.

captions.title: Copy your link
captions.line: Paste it in a text, a status or a group chat.

captions.title: Or send it on WhatsApp
captions.line: The message is written for you, with your link.

captions.title: Or let them scan it
captions.line: They open your link with their own phone camera.

captions.title: Then open Your team
captions.line: It sits at the bottom of Invite.

captions.title: Your team, three levels deep
captions.line: Everyone who joined through you, and who they brought.

captions.title: They invited
captions.line: People brought in by somebody you invited.

captions.title: One more step, then it stops
captions.line: People their people invited. No further.

captions.title: What each level earns you
captions.line: 5% of your own deals, 2% and 1% of your team's.

captions.title: Only real deals pay
captions.line: Nobody earns anything from somebody joining.
